desc:
The KEREN .22 CAL Suppressor is a leap forward in .22 Cal suppressor performance. The KEREN is more compact, lighter weight, and quieter than the KATAN. In our testing on a Taurus TX-22 pistol, the muzzle performance of the KEREN is 4-6 dB improved over the KATAN. That improvement is substantial. Especially considering the KATAN’s closest rivals are both longer and larger in diameter. Simply put, the KEREN does more with less.

The KEREN maintains a 5.56x45mm (5.56) rating with a strict barrel length restriction of 16 inches. The sound performance on a bolt action 5.56 is improved over the KATAN.

You will find that KEREN has a weight and length designed to enable boosterless functionality on 5.7×28mm (5.7) tilting barrel pistols. Cycling on a 5.7 pistol is possible, however, there are too many variables to guarantee this for all shooters, weapon systems, and ammunition types.

Key Specifications & Features:

Weight: 2.5-2.8 oz

Length: 3.7 inches

Length Added: ~3.3 inches

Diameter: 1.3”

Material: 3D-printed Grade 5 (ELI) Titanium

Finish: Cerakote (Black, FDE, Metallic)

Full-Auto/FRT Rated on RIM-FIRE ONLY

5.7x28mm Semi-Auto rated 50 rounds per minute, Not FRT Rated (4 inch barrel restriction)

.223 Remington/5.56x45mm Rated, with a strict 16 inch minimum barrel length, 10 rounds/min maximum rate of fire.

Not rated for 22 ARC, .22 CM, or any other rifle caliber besides .223/5.56
